Integration is lead-owned; coverage above counts the packet files and the in-flight w02-p02-040/w02-p02-038 files as they stand.

Attribution inconsistency (w02-p02-040 file, not this packet's): handbook/parts/p02/second-and-higher-order-logic-w02-p02-040.tex lines 162-164 say the same-type predecessor is undefinable without selection 'because Axiom 8 below is independent'; the source (Church 1940, S2 p.59) derives it from the independence of the axiom of infinity, which S4 p.61 identifies with Axioms 7 and 8 together. This packet's warning def:p02-w02-p02-041-church-predecessor (handbook/parts/p02/second-and-higher-order-logic-w02-p02-041.tex lines 617-628) states the correct attribution, so the two texts now disagree on route; the 040 sentence should be aligned by its owner.

Stale boundary text in a read-only restoration host: handbook/restoration/inherited-12537-12673.tex lines 123-133 ('Before this chapter may assert Henkin completeness ... it must still list every axiom, rule ...; No calculus name or derivability--validity biconditional is introduced here') is now discharged by thm:p02-w02-p02-040-sol-native and thm:p02-w02-p02-041-adequacy-route but still reads as an open obligation. Restoration captures are lead-owned.

Compressed step: handbook/annex/p02/second-and-higher-order-logic-w02-p02-041.tex lines 286-293 (tag 35 case of Df in the proof of thm:p02-w02-p02-041-effective) gives the inner atoms and connectives and says the code is 'assembled in the same way' instead of writing the full nested constructor term as done for tags 30-34.
